findings.finding: V4.2 changes only the position provider schema by removing three inherited uniqueItems keywords. Prompts, semantic fields, record validation, column reconstruction, evidence roles, and non-position schemas are unchanged.
Under google-genai 2.11.0, v4.1 native Schema validation fails on exactly three uniqueItems fields and v4.2 passes after their removal. No provider call occurs in preflight.
Duplicate parent-role evidence remains a hard deterministic rejection. Wire-schema removal does not weaken the validator or silently repair records.
Enum-valid semantic errors and equal-length column permutations remain structurally inspectable rather than deterministically judged. Semantic source review is still mandatory.
All 63 prompts remain identical, all 23 reviewed fixtures replay, 11 v4.2 adversarial outcomes pass, and 210 reasoning-process tests pass.
No frozen v3, v4, or v4.1 source or runner is modified; the shared Phase-4 runner remains at its locked hash.
The closed career-transition case is removed from the previously frozen ranking, leaving community space before agency acquisition by the existing SHA-256 order. No semantic reselection occurred.
No retry, fallback, response healing, evaluator, embedding, graph, global synthesis, runtime behavior, or semantic prompt repair is introduced.

nonclaims: Current SDK acceptance does not guarantee provider acceptance.
One probe cannot establish stability, transfer, product value, receipt quality, or trust.
Wire compatibility does not prove semantic alignment or correctness.
The community-space case is synthetic development evidence, not independent human gold.
